name: Abelard
description: Abelard was a planet in the Abelard system on which the Galactic Empire had established a base during the Rebellion era. Sometime after the Battle of Yavin, the Alliance to Restore the Republic attacked the base and managed to steal a stabilized ytterbium cargo.
lead_paragraphs: Abelard was a planet in the Abelard system on which the Galactic Empire had established a base during the Rebellion era. Sometime after the Battle of Yavin, the Alliance to Restore the Republic attacked the base and managed to steal a stabilized ytterbium cargo.
